props.gloss_en: R' Meir concedes regarding the New-Moon goat that we require the son of a she-goat
what is the reason? the verse says 'one' ('and one goat of the flock for a sin-offering', Bamidbar 28:15)
'one' -- the one singled out, coming [unchanged] from the six days of Creation
'an ox or a sheep' (Vayikra 22:27) -- to exclude kilayim
'or a goat' -- to exclude a nidmeh
all agree that one is not flogged on account of kilayim for its [a nidmeh's] wool
as it is said: 'you shall not wear shaatnez' (Devarim 22:11)
all agree that its wool is unfit for tekhelet
as it is said: 'you shall not wear shaatnez ... you shall make yourself twisted cords' (Devarim 22:11-12)
all agree that its wool does not become impure with nega'im
as it is said: 'in a woollen garment or in a linen garment' (Vayikra 13:47)
Rav Ashi: we too shall say: if one trellised a vine over a fig tree, its wine is unfit for libations
what is the reason? 'an offering and libations' (Vayikra 23:37)
Rav Ashi: this one [the wine] changed its scent, and that one [the flax] did not
